comment: Love this sweater! Ordered my usual medium and it fits perfectly. Super soft and arrived two days early. Will buy again.
Way too tight in the shoulders. I always wear a large and could barely get it on. Fabric feels nice but had to return.
Good jeans. Fit as expected and the color matches the photos.
Pretty dress but it’s huge on me. Sized down once and it’s still baggy in the waist. Would order a size smaller next time.
Terrible. Ordered an XL and it fits like a medium. Stitching came loose after one wash too.
The item is great. Exactly what I wanted.
Cute hoodie, very cozy. Definitely oversized though, so go down a size if you want a regular fit.
It’s fine. Fits ok, nothing special. Material is a little thin for the price.
Shirt is super long and the sleeves go past my hands. Quality seems fine but the sizing is way off.
Obsessed with the color! Runs a bit snug so I’d size up, but I kept it because it looks so good on.
Package arrived late and the zipper was broken. Waiting on my refund. Not happy.
Bought these leggings for the gym. Great fit, stay up during workouts, and no see-through problem. Happy with them!
Ordered for my daughter and the waist is tight on her. Nice material though. Exchanging for the next size up.
Perfect fit, perfect length. I’m 5'4" and the pants hit right at the ankle. 10/10.
Looked way smaller on the website. The jacket swallows me and the shoulders hang down past my arms.
Nice quality for the price. Fabric is soft and the stitching looks solid. Shipping was quick too.
Returned. The medium fit like a kids size and the fabric felt cheap and scratchy. Waste of money.
Love the oversized look! Ordered my normal size and it’s roomy in a good way. Great for lounging.
Fit is true to size but the color is more faded than in the pictures. Kinda disappointed.
Ok so I was nervous ordering online but this fit great! Normal small and it’s comfy. Would recommend.
